notes: Two pre-filled common fields (answer_type, answer) + class-specific empty dimensions. Repetition in field names (e.g. answer:cause + cause:'') is intentional — reinforces signal.

classes.name: Object Identification
classes.description: The answer names or identifies a concrete object, entity, document, technology, or substance.
classes.example_q: What is the name of the CBS affiliate in Fresno?

classes.name: Concept/Person Identification
classes.description: The answer identifies an abstract concept, classification, or person by a defining property.
classes.example_q: What are both Branko Milanovic and Joseph Stiglitz?

classes.name: Multipart Identification
classes.description: The answer requires identifying multiple distinct components.
classes.example_q: What does Warsaw host many of?

classes.name: Quantitative
classes.description: The answer is a number: a count, measurement, proportion, or recorded statistic.
classes.example_q: How many volumes does the University of Chicago Library hold?

classes.name: Temporal
classes.description: The answer is a time expression: a date, year, era, duration, or range.
classes.example_q: What year was Setanta Sports awarded Premier League rights?

classes.name: Place
classes.description: The answer is a geographic location or spatial reference.
classes.example_q: Where does the Rhine river's measurement begin?

classes.name: Agent
classes.description: The answer is who or what performed an action.
classes.example_q: Who challenged Kublai Khan's right to succeed?

classes.name: Descriptive
classes.description: The answer describes a quality, property, or characteristic of something.
classes.example_q: What kind of university is the California Institute of Technology?

classes.name: Causal
classes.description: The answer explains why something happened: the cause, reason, or enabling mechanism.
classes.example_q: Why did Berlin Huguenots switch to German?
classes.example_a: in protest against the occupation of Prussia by Napoleon

classes.name: Resultative
classes.description: The answer is the outcome, effect, or product of an action or event.
classes.example_q: What did the use of steam engines in farming lead to?
classes.example_a: increase in the land available for cultivation
